## Change

Describe what changes for readers or operators.

## Verification

List the checks and any workflows you exercised. Include a preview link when helpful.

## Reviewer focus

Call out changes to permissions, secrets, external services, or CI that need a closer look.

## Release and rollback

Describe database and configuration changes, compatibility with the previous deployment, and how to recover if the release fails. Write “None” when there are no special steps.
